# Acme Edge

The artefacts exist here. Each one is wrong in a different way, which is the
harder case: a repository that looks answered.

## Manufacturer

Acme Edge Srl, Via Larga 12, 20122 Milano, Italy.
Contact: info@acmeedge.it

## Support period

Security updates for this release are provided until 2028-03-31.

## Installing security updates

Run `npm update acme-edge` to install the latest security patch. Automatic
updates are on by default.

## Advisories

Fixed vulnerabilities are published as GitHub Security Advisories.

## Conformity

The EU declaration of conformity is published at
https://acmeedge.it/conformity/declaration.pdf
